These quantities do not have the same meaning. The independently displayed official calculation multiplies fixed hourly charges by AZ count while its LCU formula is for one GWLB. A default scalar of one cannot certify candidate/input-meaning parity.
limitation: Resolve the service billing meaning against current source-of-truth specifications and mapping contract. Do not silently reinterpret saved public GWLB counts or assert a monthly price difference from physically unequal quantities. Public missing AmazonVPC price-source errors are recorded in separate runtime failures.

reason: Both independent GUI inventories expose exactly the three build-size choices Standard (8 GB, 4 vCPUs), Large (16 GB, 8 vCPUs) and X-Large (72 GB, 36 vCPUs). Their Standard defaults agree. scope: Build-size candidate/default/input-meaning metadata in the observed supported-region GUI states; finite candidate monetary comparisons executed in Tokyo. Regional numeric build-minute comparisons are separate current-run cases.
limitation: This selector has no numerical bounds. Conditional WAF availability and other Amplify input ranges are separate rows. No regional build-size cross-product is claimed from the Tokyo finite-candidate comparisons.

officialLabel: Total number of queries Value / Unit
reason: Both selectors offer day/week/month, but current-run GUI period deltas differ. For Spark day, public monthly component is 150.00 USD while native shows 10/day × (730/24) = 304.17 sessions/month, then 304 × 1 DPU-hour × 0.50 = 152.00 USD. Read-only deployed-source investigation confirms public day conversion 30 and week conversion 52/12, and onboarding records parity check as outstanding. These differing calendar transforms are not approved by the top-level parity specification. Supported month-mode pricing remains a separate comparison.
